1.21.1.1.21.1-21.0.1-neo: Ported to 1.21 (Forge) with various improvements, recommended to switch
1.21.1.21.1.0:
- Fixed Maces not having textures
- Added damage bonuses to arrows fired by armorplus bows.
- Removed "Water Weakness" from Infused Lava Armor.
- Made all tooltips with buffs be collapsed by default, then expanded with "Shift" key.
- Added 8 more colored bricks or castle blocks.
- Made smithing recipes require infused lava crystals.
- Added proper world generation for neoforge
- Maces now have on-hit effects like the other weapons from their type.
1.21.1.23.0.0:
- Requires TheDragonLib 1.2.1+. Config is split into config/armorplus/ and old settings are not carried over.
- New rune system: extract effects into runes at the Rune Altar, then socket and upgrade them in a pedestal ritual. Works on any armor, weapon, tool or bow, including vanilla and other mods' gear.
- New sigil catalysts, Blank Runes, Socket Punch, random sockets and an AP Runes creative tab.
- Ranged runes: Piercing, Volley, Ricochet, Long Shot, Marked, Quick Draw, Ammo Saver, Seeker, Ender Shot.
- Tool runes, including the new Auto-Smelt.
- Runes can be found in world loot and added through datapacks.
- New materials: Amethyst, Glowstone, Honey, Quartz and Warden. Also shovels for every material, and many new tool sets and maces.
- Most armor effects now work per piece instead of needing the full set. They can be switched on/off in the effect screens (G/H/J/K).
- Instant effects now have a cooldown instead of firing every tick.
- ArmorPlus bows get material effects and special abilities, and work with bow enchantments.
- New /armorplus (/ap) commands: help, status, effects, rune.
- New config editors and stats.toml.
- Developer API with events.
- Fixed Elder Guardian drops, Soul Stealer requirement and soul advancements. Lower per-tick overhead.
